name: Asa made Issho☆ ~Dousei Monogatari~
original_name: 朝までいっしょ☆～同棲物語～
source:
Main character is a university student who just succeeded in finding a room to rent nearby. One day childhood friend Mariko just comes there with a big luggage claiming that she needs to live here as a part of social studies. But why her hands tremble so much then...
